title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Density Functional Theory: A Structured Framework
summary: Density Functional Theory (DFT) is widely used for atomistic simulations. However, its reach stays limited due to several limitations such as lack of accurate exchange-correlation functional, requirement of costly O(N 3) diagonalization etc. Although quantum computing offers paths forward, including variational techniques, embedding strategies, and quantum linear solvers, the discussion remains scattered.
